summary: Tokyo-based reuse company STAYGOLD buys, authenticates and wholesales pre-owned luxury goods in Japan and is introduced to ASEAN dealers, resale businesses and franchise operators.

executiveOverview: STAYGOLD, Inc. is a Tokyo reuse company founded in 2014 that buys, authenticates, wholesales and retails pre-owned luxury goods, watches, jewelry and precious metals in Japan through its BRAND REVALUE and BRING divisions. Through Japan Industrial Promotion Inc. (JIP Japan), STAYGOLD is introduced to ASEAN luxury retailers, watch and jewelry dealers, resale businesses, franchise operators and import/export companies interested in wholesale supply, trading or franchise cooperation. Terms are discussed after a qualified inquiry.

sections.heading: The opportunity
paragraphs: STAYGOLD supplies and trades pre-owned luxury goods sourced through its Japanese purchasing network. For overseas partners, the relevant capabilities are access to authenticated Japanese stock through its B2B auction, wholesale trading, and cooperation on franchise-style resale models.

The opportunity is introduced through Japan Industrial Promotion Inc. (JIP Japan) for ASEAN markets. The scope of any wholesale, trading or franchise arrangement outside Japan is defined with STAYGOLD after a qualified inquiry; no overseas terms are published.

sections.heading: About STAYGOLD
paragraphs: STAYGOLD, Inc. (株式会社STAYGOLD) is headquartered in Higashigotanda, Shinagawa-ku, Tokyo and was established on 14 April 2014 with JPY 90 million in capital. Its first BRING store opened in Shibuya in March 2011 and the group has since opened stores in Ginza, Shinjuku, Harajuku, Shibuya, Osaka, Nagoya and other cities. It reports 625 employees including part-time staff as of February 2026.

The company is organised in two divisions. BRAND REVALUE covers purchasing, wholesale (Ribao) and retail (ReMarque) of branded goods and precious metals. BRING covers purchasing and sale of apparel and accessories, including OneStyle, AWESOME, BRING KICKS and THRIFT CLOSET.

sections.heading: Goods and services
paragraphs: BRAND REVALUE focuses on bags, watches, jewelry and precious metals, bought from individual customers through a service emphasising careful customer handling. Ribao is a B2B auction for high-value brand goods; bidders can bid online and inspect items in person beforehand. ReMarque sells vintage luxury items to consumers online, with authentication by experienced appraisers.

The BRING divisions handle designer apparel, silver accessories such as Chrome Hearts and goro's, vintage and archive apparel, and sneakers. Availability of any specific brand or model for export depends on current stock and is not guaranteed.

sections.heading: Expansion plans and ASEAN focus
paragraphs: STAYGOLD's public site is in Japanese and focuses on the domestic market. The ASEAN focus, wholesale and trading cooperation and international franchise discussions described here come from the opportunity brief supplied to JIP Japan. Which ASEAN countries, volumes and partner formats are in scope is not published and should be clarified directly.

sections.heading: Who STAYGOLD wants to meet
paragraphs: Target counterparts are luxury retailers, watch and jewelry dealers, resale businesses that need a stable source of authenticated pre-owned stock, established import/export companies, and operators interested in a franchise or white-label cooperation model. Partners with licensed secondhand-goods trading experience in their own country, or an existing retail or resale channel, are the natural fit.
STAYGOLD also publicly recruits owners for BRAND REVALUE franchise stores in Japan. Whether an equivalent programme is offered overseas, and on what terms, must be confirmed with the company.

sections.heading: Points to consider
paragraphs: Trade in pre-owned luxury goods is regulated differently in each ASEAN market. Partners should check import licensing, secondhand goods rules, customs valuation, duties and any brand-related restrictions on imported goods in their own country. Authentication standards and documentation should be agreed before the first order.

STAYGOLD published notices in October and November 2026 about unauthorised access to an external system and to the BRAND REVALUE website, with possible personal data exposure, and about fraudulent emails impersonating the company. Partners should deal only through the introduction channel and verify any contact.

sections.heading: Why this is relevant for ASEAN partners
paragraphs: Dealers and resellers in ASEAN often depend on intermediaries for authenticated Japanese stock. STAYGOLD operates its own purchasing network, its own B2B auction and in-house appraisers, with a corporate history since 2014. Final fit depends on terms that are discussed after a qualified inquiry.

faqs.question: What does STAYGOLD do?
faqs.answer: STAYGOLD, Inc. is a Tokyo reuse company that buys, wholesales and retails pre-owned branded goods, including bags, watches, jewelry, precious metals, apparel and sneakers.

faqs.question: How is the wholesale business run?
faqs.answer: Its Ribao service is a B2B auction for brand goods. Registered buyers bid online, and physical pre-viewing is available before bidding in Japan. Access for overseas buyers is to be confirmed on inquiry.

faqs.question: Is a franchise available in ASEAN?
faqs.answer: Not confirmed. STAYGOLD publicly recruits BRAND REVALUE franchise owners in Japan. Overseas franchise or white-label terms and territories are discussed only after a qualified inquiry.

faqs.question: Who introduces this opportunity?
faqs.answer: It is introduced through Japan Industrial Promotion Inc. (JIP Japan), which relays qualified inquiries to the company.

faqs.question: What should an importer check first?
faqs.answer: Local licensing for secondhand and luxury goods, customs and duty treatment, authentication documentation and payment terms.
